hooks.text: An asteroid zipped closer than the Moon without anyone noticing.
How did a Washington Monument sized rock sneak past us?
An asteroid missed Earth by a hair, but nobody knew.

title: The Giant Asteroid That Sneaked Past Earth
description: An asteroid the size of the Washington Monument zipped past Earth closer than the Moon before anyone noticed.

beats.text: An asteroid zipped closer than the Moon without anyone noticing.
beats.visual: Artist's concept of an asteroid passing close to Earth and the Moon, NASA, 2018
queries: asteroid passing close to Earth concept art

beats.text: It stretched roughly 100 to 190 meters across.
beats.visual: Washington Monument exterior daylight, Washington D.C., 2020

beats.text: That made it comparable in size to the Washington Monument.
beats.visual: Asteroid space art illustration, Near Earth asteroid concept, NASA, 2018

beats.text: It was the largest asteroid to pass that close since 1971.
beats.visual: Asteroid orbit eccentric diagram, Apollo asteroid orbit diagram, NASA

beats.text: The rock approached blindly from the blinding glare of the Sun.
beats.visual: Sun glare space telescope illustration, Asteroid near Sun concept art

beats.text: Astronomers only spotted it two days after it already rushed past.
beats.visual: Mauna Loa Observatory exterior, ATLAS telescope Mauna Loa, Hawaii, 2018

beats.text: Nobody noticed when the giant rock nearly clipped us.
beats.visual: Astronomical observatory dome night, Telescope tracking stars, Mauna Loa, 2018
